column7: notifychan.validateEndpoint put the full webhook URL (%q of the raw string and the wrapped *url.Error) in its invalid-URL, plaintext, scheme, private-address and resolve errors, which NewChat/NewWebhook return as startup failures; a Slack/Teams webhook URL is itself the bearer credential. The errors now name scheme and host only (netutil.RedactURLHost / RedactErrorURLs), the same as evidencesink; the guard in internal/urlleakguard now also treats the first string parameter passed to url.Parse as a URL whatever it is named.
